notes.title: Train Mechanic Simulator 2024 Developer Update #7
notes.notes:
Hello Train Mechanics! 

We're excited to bring you the latest updates on the development of Train Mechanic Simulator 2024. A lot has happened since last update. The first batch of optimizations has arrived, and the development focus is now shifting towards completing all gameplay elements. We're working on mission scenarios, workstations for processing mechanical parts, dynamic task lists and more. The highlight system for attaching and detaching parts has been updated and workstations for processing parts have a new, more intuitive interface.

[previewyoutube=X7VrrNdE3yQ;full][/previewyoutube]


Read the new Train Mechanic Simulator 2024 Developer Update #7
https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1773220/view/4586441313632555887

We are open to your suggestions and valuable feedback, we are doing our best to make the game meet your expectations.

Add the game to your Steam Wishlist :)
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1773220/Train_Mechanic_Simulator_2024/

JOIN OUR DISCORD COMMUNITY

notes.title: Train Mechanic Simulator 2017 Update #4
notes.notes:
http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26651790/e54b5d4caa857a27949520c1542f74eb2782c2a0.jpg

Hello Players,

As we said before we are listening your comments about our game. Thanks to this we are able to deliver improvements which can improve your experience with our game. Please find below list of changes and fixes:

Changes:

- Add 2 new Music Themes for workshop instead of old ones
- Add new bolts to the parts in steam and electric locomotives
 
Fixes:

- Rear axle leaf spring - now its on mechanic table not electric
- Fix problem with the sound - now problem with lowing music volume with fast muting is fixed
- Music setting should now been saved with the game
- Improved price showing in the mounting menu
- Game Engine Upgraded to most actual version - improved stability

Again - thank you for your feedback and see you on next update!

Devs

notes.title: Train Mechanic Simulator Second Update
notes.notes:
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26651790/dbe0e4596d561dd335512a67e6a8bb28e7e9e0dd.jpg

Dear Players,

We are working hard to deliver best gameplay quality as we can. This is why we deliver to you second update of our game. Please find below list of changes. We would like to inform you that we are going to continue working about the game.

Patch 2:

- Fixes in naming parts in lockit
- Game Engine Update (improved stability, and performance)
- Fixes in table parts categories (e.g. now fuses are in proper table)
- Camera fixes - now zoom is more deep and allows to see parts from closer distance
- Fixes in crane mechanics
- Some small fixes and improvments

Hope you enjoy it.

Developers
